textoBase:
Marina studies at Nacional School. She is in the 6th grade. On Mondays, she has Math at 8 o'clock, in the morning, in her classroom. After Math, she has Science in the science lab.

At school, students must wear their uniform every day, but they mustn't use their cell phones during class. In the library, students can read books and study quietly, but they can't talk loudly or eat snacks there.

At lunchtime, everyone has to go to the cafeteria, but they don't have to bring their own food, because the school serves lunch for the students.

On Fridays, Marina has Art class in the art room, and she loves painting there. After school, she has to do her homework before she can play with her friends.
